dct_title_s: Indonesia Earthquake Flores: Damage Proxy Maps, Aug 2026
dct_description_sm: # Indonesia Earthquake Flores: Damage Proxy Maps, Aug 2026 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Earthquake Flores (Aug 2026) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: West of Flores, East Nusa Tenggara Region, Indonesia, Earthquakes, 24 August 2026, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Flores, East Nusa Tenggara Region, Indonesia, Earthquakes, 18 August 2026, v0.9 ** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2026)
